title: Power Electronics
tagline: Power semiconductors, rectifiers, DC–DC converters, inverters and converter control
summary: Power electronics processes electrical energy efficiently with switches. This course covers power semiconductor devices, rectifiers, non-isolated and isolated DC–DC converters, inverters and pulse-width modulation, the dynamics and control of converters, magnetic and thermal design, and applications from phone chargers to motor drives and solar inverters.
overview: The converter, and the one that the power is for, is the one that the limit is for, and the one that the switch is for. This course follows the power from the switch and the rectifier to the converter and the one that the inverter is for, and gives the method and the check that make it work.
We build the converter from the switch and the power, and then study how the current moves and the one that the switch is for.
outcomes: Describe the switch, and the one that the power is for, of the current and the limit
Describe the rectifier, and the one that the voltage is for, in the signal
Describe the converter, and the one that the current is for, in the limit
Describe the inverter, and the one that the waveform is for, in the limit

chapters.title: Power semiconductor switches
chapters.summary: Power diodes, MOSFETs, IGBTs, thyristors and wide-bandgap devices, switching losses and gate drives.

chapters.title: Rectifiers
chapters.summary: Single- and three-phase diode and thyristor rectifiers, harmonics and power factor.

chapters.title: DC–DC converters
chapters.summary: Buck, boost and buck–boost converters in continuous and discontinuous conduction.

chapters.title: Isolated converters
chapters.summary: Flyback, forward, push–pull and bridge converters and their transformers.

chapters.title: Inverters
chapters.summary: Single- and three-phase voltage-source inverters, and sinusoidal and space-vector PWM.

chapters.title: Converter dynamics and control
chapters.summary: Averaged models, small-signal transfer functions, and voltage-mode and current-mode control.

chapters.title: Magnetic and thermal design
chapters.summary: Design of inductors and transformers, losses, heat sinks and thermal resistance.

chapters.title: Applications of power electronics
chapters.summary: Motor drives, renewable-energy converters, battery chargers, electric vehicles and grid interfaces.
